title: Meruem Finally Realizes Netero Is More Than a Human

cuts.voiceover_text: Meruem expects another easy exchange with the old human. Then Netero moves. The attack is so fast that Meruem can barely follow the afterimage. For the first time, the King is shocked. The feeling that follows is not anger. It is admiration.

Meruem studies the pattern and finds the secret. Netero's attack begins only after his hands come together. That tiny motion is the only part faster than Meruem's eyes. It should be a fatal weakness. But Netero has turned the weakness into a weapon, and Meruem knows it could still defeat him.
Meruem sees the cost written on Netero's battered body. Training can carry anyone to a limit. Netero crossed his. The King is impressed enough to commend him.

Still, Meruem believes he has solved the statue. Its blows barely hurt him, and its hands can only follow patterns. He starts attacking from angles Netero has already used. The old man should be forced to reveal something new. But every exchange becomes another layer of the trap.

Now the battle becomes a test of endurance. Meruem recovers from every strike and launches a counter before Netero can breathe. One mistake will tear the old man apart. Netero is running out of options, but he refuses to stop playing his best move. He promises to checkmate the King. Meruem only smiles and challenges him to try.
